CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.
   D. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Prophecies about the Messiah? (1 mark)

5. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)

   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.
   D. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.
   D. Say The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

10. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Gambling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
